Title:
Artificial Intelligence Developer (AI Developer)

Company:
Aseh Tejarat Asia

Job category:
Web, programming, and software

Location:
Tehran

Employment type:
Full-time

Minimum experience:
three to six years

Salary:
Agreement

Required skill tags:
- Ai
- NLP
- Python

Gender:
it doesn't matter

Military service:
End of service

Education:
Bachelor's degree

Date posted:
2026-06-16

Valid through:
(not available)

Job description:
Specialized duties of the employee - Design and development of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning models - Development of Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems - Development of chatbots and intelligent assistants - Design and management of MLOps processes and model deployment in operational environments - Research and evaluation of new AI algorithms and technologies
Specialized knowledge and skills of the employee - Mastery of the Python programming language - Knowledge of Machine Learning (ML) - Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) - Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) - Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems - Familiarity with Generative AI models - Mastery of AI libraries such as TensorFlow and PyTorch - Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases - Familiarity with MLOps and the lifecycle of machine learning models - Skill in Prompt Engineering Proficient in software: Visual Studio Code / Anaconda / GitHub/ Docker/ Jupyter Lab **The type of cooperation is full-time and in-person.**

Company description:
Asah Tejarat Asia Company, with over 20 years of trading experience in supplying equipment, parts, and various types of compressors in the refrigeration and air conditioning industry, has always strived to provide customers with the opportunity to purchase high-quality goods through cooperation with leading international brands such as Bitter, Imbraco, Copeland, Danfoss, and... In the next steps, in line with our noble goal of having an effective and powerful presence in the market while maintaining "responsibility," we decided to be a supporter and companion to our customers by establishing the maintenance, service, and engineering consulting unit. Furthermore, in recent years, the production of various types of cooling equipment, including cold room doors, condensing units, evaporators, and coils, by utilizing the latest technology, advanced equipment, and quality raw materials, has been at the forefront of our activities. Our belief is that by adhering to commitments to our customers, paying attention to ethical values, and maintaining the principle of honesty and transparency, we will create a different and lasting experience for our customers and always move forward with dynamism towards the growth and advancement of this industry.
